title: Haze cone under a lamp (fake volumetric light)
summary: An additive, depth-write-free cone that fades at its silhouette and toward its foot: the hazy light cone under a pendant or street lamp without volumetrics.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: G.add(hazeCone([x, 2.2, z], .8, { r: .2, k: .15, color: 0xffc890 }));   // from the lamp mouth down to y .8

doc.when: Dark interiors with practical lamps (cafés, bars, interrogation rooms, mines) where a hint of haze sells the light.
doc.avoid: Bright or sunlit scenes (additive cones wash out); k above ~.25 (reads as a solid cone).
gotchas: It is marked noContact/noPick: it is light, not an object.
Pair it with a real SpotLight; the cone only fakes the scattering.

params.spread: .52 bottom radius per metre of height
